nodes.description: Public address holding admin rights; assigned msg.sender in constructor and enforced by isAdministrator modifier.
Index (0) of the default Virus entry used in all attack computations.
Cooldown constant (15 minutes) added to block.timestamp after each attack.
Crystal mining period constant (86400).
Virus mining period constant (86400) used as scaling factor for virus defence maths.
Stored engineer contract address set by setEngineerInterface.
CryptoMiningWarInterface reference used to move crystal balances.
CryptoEngineerInterface reference used for virus balances and crystal queries.
CryptoProgramFactoryInterface reference used to consume programs and read program values.
mapping(address => Player) holding virusDef, nextTimeAtk and endTimeUnequalledDef.
mapping(uint256 => Virus) holding global attack/defence multipliers.
mapping(address => bool) whitelist of authorised mini-game contracts.
Constructor: sets administrator to msg.sender and registers the three interface contracts.
Payable fallback function that accepts ether.
Pure marker returning true so the main contract recognises this mini game.
Pure marker returning true.
Admin-only function that selfdestructs the contract sending funds to addr.
No-op hook called by the main contract.
Admin-only whitelist addition; performs an external isContractMiniGame check on the candidate.
Admin-only whitelist removal.
Admin-only setter that validates and stores the mining war contract.
Admin-only setter that validates and stores the engineer contract.
Admin-only setter that stores the program factory contract without validation.
Mini-game only; resets player nextTimeAtk to the current block timestamp.
Mini-game only; overwrites player virusDef with value scaled by VIRUS_MINING_PERIOD.
Callable by mini games or the player themselves; moves virus from Engineer and adds scaled defence.
Mini-game only; subtracts scaled virus defence after a balance check.
Mini-game only; extends the unequalled defence end time using the current timestamp.
Admin-only setter for the global virus attack and defence multipliers.
Main attack entry point: validates target/programs, consumes programs externally, runs firstAttack and endAttack.
Private battle resolution using weak randomness and external Engineer.subVirus/addVirus calls.
Private revival battle executed when the first attack lost and program[1] was used.
Private settlement that computes crystal reward and performs external crystal transfers plus events.
View helper checking self-attack, attack cooldown and target eligibility.
View helper ensuring every program flag is 0 or 1.
View helper checking the target's unequalled defence window and crystal balance.
View aggregator returning player and cross-contract state.
Private pseudo-random generator seeded with block.timestamp, address and nonce.
Caller-supplied address used for admin checks, whitelist checks and as the attacker.
block.timestamp (now) used for cooldowns, validation windows and randomness seeding.
selfdestruct(addr) permanently destroys the contract and forwards its balance.
External call Engineer.subVirus to burn the attacker's virus.
External call MiningWar.subCrystal lowering the defender's crystal balance.
External call MiningWar.addCrystal crediting the attacker's crystal balance.
External call Factory.subPrograms consuming the caller's program items.
Unchecked addition p.virusDef += SafeMath.mul(_virus, VIRUS_MINING_PERIOD).
Subtraction p.virusDef -= _virus after a require guard.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, _addr, randNonce)) used as randomness, predictable by miners.
External MiniGameInterface.isContractMiniGame() call on an admin-supplied address before whitelisting.
attack: target address being attacked.
attack: amount of virus the caller commits.
attack: array of four program flags.
firstAttack: scaled attacker virus.
firstAttack: program flags passed through.
firstAttack: program percentage values read from the factory.
endAttack: battle outcome flag.
endAttack: final attack power, emitted in the event.
endAttack: final defence power, emitted in the event.
endAttack: program flags emitted in the Programs event.
againAttack: revived virus amount for the second round.
validateAttack: attacker address.
validateAttack: defender address.
canAttack: address whose eligibility is checked.
getData: address queried.
randomNumber: address mixed into the seed.
randomNumber: modulo upper bound.
addVirusDef: virus amount pulled from the engineer contract.
subVirusDef: virus amount to remove.
setVirusInfo: new global virus attack multiplier.
setVirusInfo: new global virus defence multiplier.
upgrade: beneficiary address for selfdestruct.
setContractsMiniGame: candidate mini-game address.
setPlayerVirusDef: raw defence value before scaling.
firstAttack: random attack rate derived from msg.sender.
firstAttack: random defence rate derived from the defender address.
firstAttack: storage pointer to the defender's Player struct.
endAttack: crystal reward computed and transferred.
endAttack: random 10-50 percent loot rate.
endAttack: defender crystal balance read from the engineer contract.
addTimeUnequalledDefence: running unequalled defence end time.
getData: memory copy of the queried Player struct.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as administrator in the constructor.
msg.sender selects the attacker in attack and drives the players mapping lookup.
msg.sender is compared against miniGames and _addr to authorise addVirusDef.
isAdministrator modifier restricts setContractsMiniGame to msg.sender == administrator.
msg.sender seeds rateAtk and receives refunded virus inside firstAttack.
msg.sender is forwarded as _atkAddress when validating the attack.
caller identity determines whose cooldown is checked indirectly via validateAttack.
p.nextTimeAtk is set directly to now, making cooldown state timestamp dependent.
attack sets players[msg.sender].nextTimeAtk = now + HALF_TIME_ATK.
validateAttack compares players[_atkAddress].nextTimeAtk <= now.
canAttack compares players[_addr].endTimeUnequalledDef < now.
addTimeUnequalledDefence clamps the stored end time against now.
randomNumber hashes block.timestamp, making randomness miner-manipulable.
attack requires validateAttack(msg.sender, _defAddress) before proceeding.
attack requires validatePrograms(_programs) before proceeding.
attack invokes the private firstAttack battle routine.
attack settles the battle through endAttack.
attack conditionally calls againAttack when program[1] is set and the player lost.
againAttack finishes by calling endAttack with round 2.
firstAttack draws its attack and defence rates from randomNumber.
againAttack draws its attack and defence rates from randomNumber.
endAttack computes the loot rate with randomNumber.
validateAttack delegates the target eligibility check to canAttack.
getData exposes the canAttack result.
upgrade executes selfdestruct(addr), irreversibly destroying the contract.
attack performs the external Factory.subPrograms call.
firstAttack performs the external Engineer.subVirus call.
endAttack performs the external MiningWar.subCrystal call on the defender.
endAttack performs the external MiningWar.addCrystal call for the attacker.
setContractsMiniGame calls isContractMiniGame on an admin-supplied address.
randomNumber builds its seed from block.timestamp and a nonce, producing weak randomness.
addVirusDef mutates player defence through the unchecked += operation.
subVirusDef mutates player defence through the -= operation.
The external MiningWar.subCrystal call hands control to another contract mid-settlement.
The external MiningWar.addCrystal call hands control to another contract mid-settlement.
The external Factory.subPrograms call executes before the battle state is finalised.
The external Engineer.subVirus call lets the callee re-enter before pDef is updated.
isAdministrator modifier on upgrade requires msg.sender == administrator.
isAdministrator modifier on setVirusInfo requires msg.sender == administrator.
isAdministrator modifier on setContractsMiniGame requires msg.sender == administrator.
isAdministrator modifier on removeContractMiniGame requires msg.sender == administrator.
isAdministrator modifier gates the mining war interface setter.
isAdministrator modifier gates the engineer interface setter.
isAdministrator modifier gates the factory interface setter.
addVirusDef requires miniGames[msg.sender] == true or msg.sender == _addr.
setContractsMiniGame writes miniGames[_addr] = true after an external check.
removeContractMiniGame clears miniGames[_addr].
attack reads and writes players[msg.sender] and players[_defAddress].
firstAttack loads a storage pointer into players[_defAddress] and mutates virusDef.
againAttack loads a storage pointer into players[_defAddress] and mutates virusDef.
validateAttack reads nextTimeAtk from the players mapping.
canAttack reads endTimeUnequalledDef from the players mapping.
setAtkNowForPlayer writes nextTimeAtk into the players mapping.
setPlayerVirusDef overwrites virusDef in the players mapping.
addTimeUnequalledDefence updates endTimeUnequalledDef in the players mapping.
getData copies the Player struct out of the players mapping.
setVirusInfo writes atk and def into viruses[VIRUS_NORMAL].
firstAttack reads viruses[VIRUS_NORMAL].atk and .def as multipliers.
againAttack copies viruses[VIRUS_NORMAL] into memory for the battle.
The constructor initialises viruses[VIRUS_NORMAL] = Virus(1,1).
The constructor calls setMiningWarInterface.
The constructor calls setEngineerInterface.
The constructor calls setFactoryInterface.
setPlayerVirusDef multiplies _value by VIRUS_MINING_PERIOD when storing defence.
attack scales _virus by VIRUS_MINING_PERIOD and divides battle results by it.
firstAttack returns victory, atk, def and dead counts back into attack for settlement.
againAttack passes its battle results into endAttack.
endAttack calls MiningWar.subCrystal and MiningWar.addCrystal.
firstAttack queries Engineer.addVirus for the attacking player.
endAttack queries Engineer.calCurrentCrystals for the loot base.
canAttack requires Engineer.calCurrentCrystals(_addr) >= 5000.
getData reads current virus and crystals from the engineer contract.
addVirusDef calls Engineer.subVirus to move virus out of the player.
attack reads getProgramsValue and consumes programs through the Factory.
attack sets the next allowed attack time using HALF_TIME_ATK.
setVirusInfo targets the VIRUS_NORMAL entry of the viruses mapping.
firstAttack indexes viruses with VIRUS_NORMAL for its multipliers.
The constructor seeds viruses[VIRUS_NORMAL] with the default Virus(1,1).
attack uses _defAddress as the battle target.
attack uses _virus as the committed attacker virus.
attack validates and forwards _programs to the factory and battles.
firstAttack begins with _virus as the attack power.
firstAttack branches on the incoming _programs flags.
firstAttack scales attack and defence using programsValue percentages.
endAttack only computes a reward when victory is true.
endAttack emits atk in the Attack event.
endAttack emits def in the Attack event.
endAttack emits the program flags in the Programs event.
againAttack uses the revived _virus as this round's attack power.
validateAttack compares _atkAddress against _defAddress.
validateAttack checks the defender's players entry via _defAddress.
canAttack evaluates the eligibility of _addr.
getData aggregates state for _addr.
randomNumber mixes _addr into the hash seed.
randomNumber reduces the hash modulo _maxNumber.
addVirusDef scales _virus and forwards it to the engineer contract.
subVirusDef scales _virus and guards the subtraction with it.
setVirusInfo writes _atk into the stored Virus struct.
setVirusInfo writes _def into the stored Virus struct.
upgrade forwards addr to selfdestruct as the balance beneficiary.
setContractsMiniGame whitelists _addr after the external probe.
setPlayerVirusDef scales _value by VIRUS_MINING_PERIOD.
firstAttack derives the attack multiplier from the weak rateAtk randomness.
firstAttack derives the defence multiplier from the weak rateDef randomness.
firstAttack mutates the defender's stored virusDef through the pDef pointer.
endAttack computes reward and passes it to the crystal transfer calls.
endAttack derives the loot percentage from the weak randomNumber output.
endAttack bases the reward on the defender's crystal balance.
addTimeUnequalledDefence accumulates into currentTimeUnequalled before storing.
getData reads its return values out of the memory Player copy p.

normalization_plan.reason: Target address parameter is only meaningful inside attack's battle orchestration.
Committed virus amount is consumed solely by attack before being scaled and forwarded.
Program flags parameter is validated and forwarded only by attack.
Scaled virus value exists only as input to the private firstAttack battle.
Program flags are read only to branch inside firstAttack.
Factory program percentages are applied only within firstAttack maths.
Outcome flag only gates the reward branch inside endAttack.
Final attack value is only emitted by endAttack.
Final defence value is only emitted by endAttack.
Program array is only used for the endAttack event emission.
Revived virus amount is exclusively the input of the second-round battle.
Attacker address is compared inside the validateAttack precondition.
Defender address is queried only by the validateAttack precondition.
Queried address is used solely by the canAttack eligibility check.
Queried address is only used to assemble the getData view result.
Seed address contributes only to the randomNumber hash.
Modulo bound is used only to clamp the randomNumber output.
Virus amount is scaled and folded directly into the defence addition.
Virus amount is scaled and drives the guarded defence subtraction.
Attack multiplier is stored only by the setVirusInfo admin setter.
Defence multiplier is stored only by the setVirusInfo admin setter.
Beneficiary address flows straight into the selfdestruct sink.
Candidate address is probed and whitelisted only inside that setter.
Raw defence value is scaled and written only by that setter.
Attack rate is produced by the weak randomNumber source relied on by firstAttack.
Defence rate is produced by the same weak randomness source in firstAttack.
Storage pointer is a transient handle on the defender inside firstAttack.
Computed reward value is what feeds the external crystal transfer sink.
Loot percentage comes from the weak randomNumber call inside endAttack.
Crystal balance snapshot is a transient value used only for reward maths.
Running end time is a transient accumulator local to that updater.
Memory struct copy exists purely to populate the getData return values.
